label: step-001
payload: Write a file called 'inventory.py' — a small inventory module, at least 100 lines long, with a module docstring and these terse-named functions, each documented: 'qty_chk(item, n)' returns whether n <= item["stock"]; 'add_item(store, item)' appends an item; 'rm_item(store, name)' removes by name; 'find_item(store, name)' returns the matching item; 'tot_value(store)' sums price * stock. Also write 'tests/test_inventory.py' covering 'qty_chk' and 'tot_value'.
